title: Hot oil hair treatment
subtitle: A pre-shampoo conditioning treatment for dry or damaged hair
excerpt: A pre-shampoo conditioning treatment of warmed coconut oil and argan oil applied to dry hair from root to tip, then left under a warm towel for 20 to 30 minutes before shampooing out. The heat softens the hair and lets the oils penetrate more deeply, reducing dryness and frizz. One treatment uses 30 to 40 ml; mix a small batch per session.
sourceNotes: Pre-shampoo oil treatment tradition documented in The Handmade Apothecary by Kim Walker and Vicky Chown (2017, Kyle Books). Coconut oil penetration of hair shaft: shown in Journal of Cosmetic Science 54(2):175 to 192 (2003, Rele and Mohile), coconut oil reduces protein loss in both damaged and undamaged hair when used as a pre- or post-wash treatment. Argan oil as a conditioning additive: Cosmetics & Toiletries manufacturer survey, 2019.

recipe.yieldDescription: 1 treatment (30 to 40 ml, for shoulder-length hair)
recipe.batchNotes: Mix fresh per treatment. Pre-mixed oil is stable for months but applying warm oil directly is more effective than applying oil that has been stored.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The oil blend can be stored in a small bottle and warmed in the hands before use. Shake before each use.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Mixed oil blend keeps one year in a sealed bottle at room temperature. Discard if the oil smells rancid or sharp.

glossaryTerms.definition: A plant-derived oil used as the main base in a blend, diluting any essential oils and applying the treatment to the skin or hair. Coconut and argan are both carrier oils.

content.text: Hot oil hair treatment is a pre-shampoo conditioning mask of warmed coconut oil and argan oil applied to dry hair from root to tip, covered with a warm towel for 20 to 30 minutes, then shampooed out. The heat softens the hair and lets the oils penetrate more deeply, reducing dryness and frizz. One treatment uses 30 to 40 ml for shoulder-length hair.

items.prepNote: refined coconut oil is odourless; virgin coconut oil adds a faint coconut scent; both work equally
light and non-greasy; adds conditioning without the heaviness of coconut alone

content.text: Combine the coconut oil and argan oil in a small bowl or jar. Warm by setting the container in a bowl of hot water for two minutes, or rub the mixed oil between the palms for 30 seconds. The oil should feel warm to the touch, not hot. Test on the inner wrist before applying to the scalp.

Section dry hair and work the warm oil through from root to tip, massaging the scalp and distributing through the length. Use a comb to spread evenly. Apply more oil at the ends, which are typically drier and more porous.

Wrap the hair in a warm towel or a shower cap. Leave for 20 to 30 minutes. The warmth helps the oils absorb more deeply. Rinse thoroughly by shampooing twice to remove the oil completely, under-rinsing leaves hair feeling heavy and flat.
Apply a small amount to the inside of the forearm and wait 24 hours before using on the full scalp. Argan oil is a tree nut-derived oil; anyone with nut allergies should patch test first.
Mixed oil blend keeps one year in a sealed bottle. Coconut oil solidifies below 24°C, warm the bottle in the hands before use. Discard if the oil smells rancid or sharp.
